back: Names a grid square: the easting on its west side, then the northing on its south side (its south-west corner).
Easting + tenths, then northing + tenths, e.g. 425 576. Locates a point to 100 m on a 1:50 000 map.
Angular distance north or south of the Equator (0°), up to 90°N/S. Lines of latitude run east–west.
Angular distance east or west of the Prime Meridian (0°, Greenwich), up to 180°E/W. Meridians meet at the poles.
15° = 1 hour; 1° = 4 minutes. Places to the east are ahead; places to the west are behind.
Same side of Greenwich: subtract. Opposite sides (one E, one W): add.
Roughly the 180° meridian. Crossing eastwards: go back one day. Crossing westwards: go forward one day.
1 degree = 60 minutes (60′), so 17°30′S is halfway between 17°S and 18°S.
60 zones, each 6° of longitude wide; positions in metres east and north. Zimbabwe lies in UTM zones 35 and 36.
